import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.ModuleGlobalGeneration
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModuleEvaluation
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModuleGeneratedSections
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianEmbedding
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyTwistedKernel
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyDegreeComparison
import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Ledger.ResidueOneAlgClosed

/-!
# Native generation of divisor modules on geometric fibres

The cohomological point evaluations produce local generators of the actual
structure-sheaf module `O(D)`. Factoring these section maps through the
pullback--pushforward counit proves its epimorphy.

On algebraically closed extensions of a fixed smooth proper geometrically
integral curve, the fixed-coordinate bound is uniform. This is the geometric
fibre generation input for campaign D2 and Kleiman's section 4 construction.
The intrinsic divisor twist of an actual field-family Cartier kernel is
generated under the same bound; field pullback of a chosen original twist
and relative base change remain separate obligations.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverModule overModule

variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}}
  [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

/-- Surjective cohomological point evaluations generate the native divisor module. -/
theorem divisorModules_counit_epi_of_point_evaluation_surjective (D : X.CurveDivisor)
    (hD : ∀ {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X),
      Function.Surjective (Sheaf.HModule.map (devissageSES K hx D).g 0)) :
    Epi ((Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))).counit.app (divisorModules K D)) := by
  apply Modules.counit_epi_of_locally_generating_unit_hom
  have hlocal (x : X) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) :
      ∃ (s : Modules.Hom (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) (divisorModules K D))
        (W : X.Opens), x ∈ W ∧ IsIso ((Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map s) := by
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ :=
      exists_divisorModules_section_ord_eq_of_hModule_zero_surjective K hx D (hD hx)
    let φ := Modules.homOfGlobalSection (divisorModules K D) s
    obtain ⟨W, hxW, _, hφ⟩ :=
      exists_affineOpen_isIso_restrict_homFromUnit_of_ord_eq K φ hx
        (by simpa [φ] using hs)
    exact ⟨φ, W, hxW, hφ⟩
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x = genericPoint X
  · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_ne_genericPoint_of_smoothCurve K (X := X)
    obtain ⟨s, W, hzW, hs⟩ := hlocal z hz
    refine ⟨s, W, ?_, hs⟩
    rw [hx]
    exact genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty ⟨z, hzW⟩
  · exact hlocal x hx

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.FiberCoordinateData

/-- The fixed-coordinate bound generates native divisor modules on every geometric fibre.
The original curve is over an arbitrary field; algebraic closedness is required only
of the geometric extension on which closed points have residue degree one. -/
theorem uniformGeneration_fixedCoordinate_counit_epi
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (κ : Type u) [Field κ] [Algebra k κ] [IsAlgClosed κ] :
    letI : (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
      .ofHom (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom
    letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
        ((Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom)
    ∀ D : (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.CurveDivisor,
      fixedCoordinateDegree C + (genus C : ℤ) + 1 ≤ Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg κ D →
        Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
          (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom).counit.app (Scheme.divisorModules κ D)) := by
  letI : (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
    .ofHom (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
      ((Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom)
  intro D hD
  apply Scheme.divisorModules_counit_epi_of_point_evaluation_surjective κ D
  intro x hx
  apply uniformGeneration_fixedCoordinate_at_threshold C κ hx D
  have hpoint : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg κ (Scheme.CurveDivisor.single hx 1) = 1 := by
    change Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg κ (Finsupp.single ⟨x, hx⟩ 1) = 1
    rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_single,
      Scheme.residueDeg_eq_one_of_isAlgClosed (K := κ) hx]
    norm_num
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_add, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_neg, hpoint]
  omega

/-- The actual kernel of an intrinsic divisor twist of a field-family
Cartier quotient is generated at the fixed-coordinate bound. The Weil
divisor in the bound is extracted from that family's quotient stalks. -/
theorem uniformGeneration_divisorTwistKernel_counit_epi
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (κ : Type u) [Field κ] [Algebra k κ] [IsAlgClosed κ] :
    letI : (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
      .ofHom (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom
    letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
        ((Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom)
    ∀ (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom
        (Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ)))))
      (A : (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.CurveDivisor),
      fixedCoordinateDegree C + (genus C : ℤ) + 1 ≤
        Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg κ (A - (show
          (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.CurveDivisor from x.effectiveWeilDivisor)) →
      Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom).counit.app
          (kernel ((Scheme.Modules.tensorObj_right_unitor (Scheme.divisorModules κ A)).inv ≫
            Scheme.Modules.tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 (Scheme.divisorModules κ A))
              (Scheme.DivFamily.normalizedQuotient x)))) := by
  letI : (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
    .ofHom (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
      ((Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom)
  intro x A hA
  let e := Scheme.DivFamily.divisorTwistKernelIso x A
  let D : (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.CurveDivisor := x.effectiveWeilDivisor
  let adj := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom
  haveI : Epi (adj.counit.app (Scheme.divisorModules κ (A - D))) :=
    uniformGeneration_fixedCoordinate_counit_epi C κ _ hA
  haveI : Epi (adj.counit.app (Scheme.divisorModules κ (A - D)) ≫ e.inv) :=
    inferInstance
  exact epi_of_epi_fac
    (h := adj.counit.app (Scheme.divisorModules κ (A - D)) ≫ e.inv)
    (adj.counit.naturality e.inv)

/-- The native-generation epi with the degree of the family exposed directly.

The field-test degree comparison identifies the weighted degree of
`effectiveWeilDivisor` with `d`. Consequently the bound on the chosen twist `A`
depends only on the family degree, as required by the D2 construction. -/
theorem uniformGeneration_divisorTwistKernel_counit_epi_of_hasFiberDeg
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (κ : Type u) [Field κ] [Algebra k κ] [IsAlgClosed κ]
    (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom
      (Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ)))))
    (A : (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.CurveDivisor)
    {d : ℕ} (hx : x.HasFiberDeg d)
    (hA : fixedCoordinateDegree C + (genus C : ℤ) + 1 ≤
      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg κ A - (d : ℤ)) :
    letI : (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.Over
        (Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) := .ofHom (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom
    letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
        ((Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom)
    Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom).counit.app
        (kernel ((Scheme.Modules.tensorObj_right_unitor (Scheme.divisorModules κ A)).inv ≫
          Scheme.Modules.tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 (Scheme.divisorModules κ A))
            (Scheme.DivFamily.normalizedQuotient x)))) := by
  letI : (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.Over
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
    .ofHom (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
      ((Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom)
  have hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg κ
      (show (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.CurveDivisor from x.effectiveWeilDivisor) =
        (d : ℤ) := by
    exact x.deg_effectiveWeilDivisor_eq_of_hasFiberDeg hx
  apply uniformGeneration_divisorTwistKernel_counit_epi C κ x A
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_add,
    Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_neg, hdeg]
  omega

end AlgebraicGeometry.FiberCoordinateData
